confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on crowd-sourced and travel-site figures, several undated or from 2025, and no official Geneva price survey was found. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors are the best supported. Midrange meal is inferred from dinner-for-two data that included wine, minus drinks. Cocktail and wine are bounded estimates, not direct observations. Wine uses the local bottle-to-glass relationship and the Expatistan bottle price, so it is the least certain drink anchor. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Geneva's high-cost accommodation market; no booking pages or listings were checked. The FX rate came from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rate page for 2026-10-16 and was not verified by opening the table. It is close to a Banque de France EUR cross-rate (about 0.7010 for 14 Oct) and the RBA-summarised 14 Oct figure (0.7002). The CHF-to-USD conversion used for the USD anchors is not sourced: it assumes roughly 0.93 CHF per EUR and the Banque de France EUR/USD cross, giving about 1.20 USD per CHF. Treat the USD anchors as bounded estimates that could move with the CHF rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced on Swiss city cost levels, anchored to Geneva-specific restaurant and bar data where available. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a high-cost Swiss/Western European business and tourism city, with hostel and hotel tiers set to Geneva's typically higher room rates than neighbouring French or German cities.
